values.note: Operator rate page (©2026): RV sites $45 a night with water and electric, $50 full hookup, $55 premium full hookup, for two people before tax; $15 per extra adult, $5 per child 6-17. Weekly: 6 nights, 7th free. Monthly only November 1 - April 1 (call). Optional $10 site-lock fee for a specific site.

note:
Sites appear to be attractive and well-spaced.
Family-run campground on Laurel Creek Road, 2 miles south of the New River Gorge Canyon Rim Visitor Center; it is not a rafting outfitter. A pond (no swimming) and walking loops on the 44 acres. --Claude
summary: Operator site, FAQ, 2026 map and rates page: fees $45-55 confirmed, 50-amp with water and sewer (sewer added), 29 sites, showers/laundry/dump/Wi-Fi/store, year-round (winter: full-hookup, self-contained only), holiday 2-night minimum, Good Sam + military 10% confirmed. Cleared the derived max_rig_ft 22 (operator: sites 'for every variety of RV', no lengths). Note: dropped the old '$41 for 22 ft' price line (unattributed, superseded) and the wrong 'rafting outfitter ... riverside sites' text.
flags: Price gate: base $45 (W/E, 2 people) is under US$50; New River Gorge NP is 5 km away anyway; Good Sam 10% applies.

RV fit unconfirmed by length: no site lengths are published; the old note said the back-in 30-amp/water sites suit 22-ft RVs, while the operator says the 29 sites are 'for every variety of RV' (the Firefly form asks RV length, which a browser check could test).
